content.short: chUSD synthetic dollar whose staked version earns yield from US private credit.
content.description: CHATEAU gives on-chain access to returns from off-chain funds. Users swap stablecoins for chUSD, an overcollateralized synthetic dollar, and stake it as schUSD, an ERC-4626 vault invested in a widely diversified portfolio of US small-business loans. The team reports a one-year IRR above 20%, and schUSD can be reused across DeFi. It is live on Hyperliquid and Plasma and backed by Hack VC.
content.meta: Stake chUSD as schUSD to earn from a diversified US private credit portfolio, with DeFi composability on Plasma and Hyperliquid.
